faqs.q: When do I need a service drop upgrade or panel modernization?
faqs.a: When your panel overheats, breakers trip frequently, or you plan to expand your electrical load. We modernize the panel and condition it for energy efficiency with certified materials, fully compliant with the Costa Rican Electrical Code.

faqs.q: What does preventive electrical maintenance include?
faqs.a: Panel inspection, torque checks on connections, thermography of hot spots, verification of differential protection devices and load measurements. It is the most cost-effective way to avoid expensive downtime for businesses and hotels.

faqs.q: Do you work on both new builds and remodels?
faqs.a: Yes. We participate from the electrical design stage on new construction to circuit redistribution in remodels, minimizing disruption to your operation with prior planning and certified personnel.
